name: Tutoring practice, engine-assisted
summary: Run a tutoring business where prep, practice material, and progress diagnosis are generated per student instead of consuming your evenings.

endpoints.description: Study guide generation — any subject, any grade, any country
Practice quiz with adaptive difficulty and answer explanations
Misconception diagnosis — pinpoints the exact knowledge gap behind a wrong answer
Exam-style practice questions — 200+ exams, rubric-matched difficulty
Full mock exam simulation — timed, scored, with performance report
Spaced-repetition flashcard set — import into Anki or Quizlet

payment.pricing_note: Prices shown are the live public catalog — the same wholesale sheet agents pay per call. No subscription.
payment.human_onramp: Self-serve starter key (no crypto wallet needed): https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/start/?bp=tutoring-practice — scoped key with a $0.25 trial balance; top up by card (Stripe) or USDC. API: POST https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/api/wholesale/register {contact, scope: "edupulse"}. Email fallback: info@theaslangroupllc.com with subject "Starter key: tutoring-practice".

setup_steps: Pick one subject and one exam you already know cold. Depth beats breadth for referrals.
Take two students at a founding rate and run the full engine-assisted loop: pre-session materials, misconception diagnosis, weekly parent note.
Raise your rate for student three. Your prep quality is now visibly better than the hourly-tutor norm.
Ask both founding families for one referral each at week four, with a specific sentence they can forward.
licensing_notes: Tutoring is unlicensed nearly everywhere. Two practical notes: background-check expectations are real when you work with minors (get one proactively; parents notice), and if you advertise special-education expertise, know your jurisdiction’s rules about what only credentialed specialists may claim.

compliance.earnings: Educational content. No earnings claims or income projections; results depend on operator effort, market, and pricing.
compliance.posture: Flat-fee self-help document preparation where documents are involved: the customer signs and files; the operator never represents clients or works on contingency.
